about: The tractus of the formulary “Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: God has graced us in His beloved Son, in whom we have redemption through His Blood. The remission of sins, according to the riches of His grace, which has superabounded in us. Being justified freely by His grace, through the redemption which is in Christ Jesus. Whom God has set forth as a propitiation through faith in His Blood.

ex.w025: The participle describes us, justified freely by His grace. Its subject is understood, not expressed by a separate word here.
